description: This file defines a C# interface for an Orleans grain, specifying a contract for grains with a GUID compound key and a method to retrieve a counter value.

classes.name: IFilteredImplicitSubscriptionWithExtensionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface with a GUID compound key, providing a method to get a counter value.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Asynchronous method that retrieves an integer counter value from the grain.
